notes:
Passed the acceptance gate on the fake backend (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). No hardware was attached, no hardware backend was run, and no hardware test was performed. The package is model-authored and unreviewed: the loader refuses the R2 hardware backend until a human sets reviewed_by. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names PythonObjectDriver and expected the family helper; the package is a direct decorated Driver over the card entry symbol fluid_control.cli.session:FluidControlSession (decision direct-driver). A direct Driver is used because the actions take a channel, a volume in uL and a liquid-class key, call the native session, and return an output built from the input; the family's static result map cannot express that. COVERAGE: reads channels, liquid_classes, fluid_status and pressure; write pressure via cap.device.configure.v1 (operator_required, filled by site-limits.example.json); actions x-cap.festo-se.aspirate.v1, x-cap.festo-se.dispense.v1 and x-cap.festo-se.mix.v1; safe-state action x-cap.festo-se.deactivate.v1; @estop calls the session's set_pressure(0). NOT COVERED: tip handling (pickup_tips/eject_tips), raw direct_command/valve_timed calibration moves, the set_new_calibration write, multi-channel commands in one action call (the extension is single-channel), and gantry-dependent motion (move_axis/raise_arm/home/where) because it needs an externally supplied mounted gantry/axis and the clone states no travel bound. The fake has two active channels and two liquid classes and pressure 0 as test data only; every such value is marked placeholder and none is a Fact or a Limit. All numeric limits are operator_required: the clone documents units and the calibration model but never the pressure range, the configured channel set, a volume range or a cycle bound; site-limits.example.json is an example overlay only. SAFETY: the clone documents no independent hardware e-stop, so estop_physical_ref is absent and no safety-rated stop is claimed; the @estop and the safe-state action release the output pressure to the neutral 0 mbar and the safe-state action also deselects every valve. set_pressure issues the pressure command before polling, but it can wait up to the upstream 30 second timeout if the reading never reaches the target, and the synchronous upstream aspirate/dispense/mix calls share the same PGVA/VAEM controllers with no cancellation hook, so a running operation is not preempted by the e-stop and its controller call can contend with the e-stop; the e-stop path was never exercised on hardware. The hardware factory takes the instrument config and the concrete engine class and was never imported or run by the gate.
